yamlCheck.dateAnchor: No clear absolute adventure date is spoken. May and 31 years since 1718 supply partial context only. Using YAML May 8, 1749 for the harbor opening, the two voyage sunrises and final midnight/dawn end on May 11.
yamlCheck.explanation: Current play starts at the already-woken harbor meeting. The voyage from the 3 p.m. cave departure to the island takes just over 48 hours and crosses two nights; sailing onward reaches midnight and the following dawn. These establish the entire three-boundary YAML span conditional on its start. The three-day Nevium recap and Dorian’s lost decade are earlier history. No rest proposal or YAML end is used to fill time.
